judge.rationale: The candidate only generated a planning artifact (`.lore/dod.md`), a partial spec (`specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md`), and a failing acceptance test suite (`src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts`), stopping after the red phase of TDD. No actual implementation in `src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts` was written, nor was `ajv` added to `package.json`. Consequently, the added tests fail immediately and none of the documentation updates (`README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`) or orchestrator integration tests requested by the ticket were delivered.
